title: Spectral Certificates and Projection-DPP Rounding for Determinantal MAP Selection
abstract: arXiv:2606.19411v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Selecting a fixed-size subset that maximizes the determinant of a positive semidefinite kernel is the MAP problem for a size-constrained determinantal point process and the classical maximum-entropy sampling problem. Although this discrete problem is NP-hard, a classical spectral bound gives an efficiently computable ceiling using the leading eigenvalues. The same ceiling is the exact optimum of the associated Stiefel relaxation, so the continuous problem is already solved by the leading eigenspace. We study what this eigenspace implies for discrete rounding.   The leading eigenvectors induce a projection determinantal point process whose probability for a subset equals its squared coordinate volume. We prove that the gap between the determinant of any subset and the spectral ceiling is at most its negative log-probability under this distribution. translated_title: 谱证书与投影DPP舍入用于行列式MAP选择
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.19411v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：选择一个固定大小的子集，以最大化正半定核的行列式，这是尺寸约束行列式点过程的最大后验（MAP）问题，也是经典的最大熵采样问题。尽管这个离散问题是NP难的，但经典的谱界通过主导特征值提供了一个可高效计算的上界。这个上界也是相关Stiefel松弛的精确最优值，因此连续问题已由主导特征空间解决。我们研究这个特征空间对离散舍入的含义。主导特征向量诱导一个投影行列式点过程，其中子集的概率等于其坐标体积的平方。我们证明，任何子集的行列式与谱上界之间的差距最多为其在此分布下的负对数概率。因此，完整性差距受最小熵限制，并在特定条件下等于该值。
tldr: 本文证明了投影行列式点过程下的谱上界与子集行列式之间的差距受负对数概率限制，从而将完整性差距与最小熵联系起来。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the gap between the spectral bound and subset determinants under a projection determinantal point process is bounded by negative log-probability, linking the integrality gap to min-entropy.
